propositions: commit_tickets_branch does not exist; _commit_binding_store_snapshot composes raw git_adapter.add and git_adapter.commit outside the locked transaction, causing unintended files like .bridge_state/last-pass.json to be staged and committed when using the commit_and_push_tickets_branch seam's git add -A
test_unchanged_second_pass_preserves_binding_store_bytes_and_head fails when .bridge_state/last-pass.json is committed on every idempotent pass, advancing HEAD when it should not

_commit_binding_store_snapshot must be refactored to call a new pathspec-aware locked commit seam instead of raw git operations, staging only the intended 5 .bridge_state files and never the per-pass timestamp

the new commit_tickets_branch(tracker, message=, paths=None, strict=False, author_name=None, author_email=None) helper must extract the locked commit phase from commit_and_push_tickets_branch, support optional pathspec filtering, and never push

per-file idempotency requires pathspec-scoped git status --porcelain to detect changes in any of the 5 named files individually, so that a single-file change (e.g. bindings-retired.json) commits and stages while all-unchanged commits nothing
the raw-git-ok marker on reconcile_helpers.py must be removable after the seam extraction, and commit_and_push_tickets_branch callers must observe no behavior change
